zh-CN.title: 活动原地查看与功能状态优化
items: 菜单、广场和聊天卡片可直接打开活动详情，关闭后保留原页面，不再跳转广场
活动详情统一加载动画，各活动独立加载自己的主题，不再闪现八仙背景
未开放的聊天、广场、投稿、科研和开发使用统一状态页，提供返回可用功能的入口

en.title: Activities without leaving your page
items: Activity details open over menus, feeds, and chat cards without navigating to Square; closing preserves your page
Activities share one loading animation and load their own theme without briefly displaying Baxian artwork
Disabled Chats, Square, Submissions, Research, and Developer tools share a clear status page with links to available features
